description: This file defines the interface class IFactories within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, providing factory methods for creating web-related proxy objects such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC. It also includes type definitions for deprecated classes WorkerPool and Factories.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class for creating various web-related proxy objects, such as requests, responses, file bodies, and JSONRPC messages.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::FileBody object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::JSONBodyType of Core::JSONRPC::Message.
